personality: 7 Dark-First Utility, with 6 Glass / Luxe surfaces for a premium Serie A feel
personality_one_liner: A high-octane, premium command center for Serie A fantasy football that prioritizes stats and matchday performance with vibrant pitch-green accents.

spacing.rule: High-density data requires strict layout alignment. Use md spacing for component internals, and lg/xl for section separation. Avoid extraneous padding on live stats screens.

do's: Use frosted glass overlays (expo-blur) for sticky headers, the bottom tab bar, and the tactical lineup pitch background.
Overlay glass on the hero background images to ensure text readability.
dont's: Do not use blur on player stat cards or list items to preserve high-contrast readability.

screens.name: Onboarding & Login
screens.purpose: Immerse the user in the football manager mindset before entering the app.
screens.layout: Full-bleed background image with a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) at the bottom. Sticky brandPrimary CTA button.

screens.name: Home Dashboard
screens.purpose: A command center showing the current matchday status, user's active lineup summary, and brief league standings.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders for the current lineup and league ranking cards.
states.empty: Illustration of a tactic board prompting the user to join a league or create a lineup.

screens.layout: Hero card at the top displaying matchday countdown/status. Below, a horizontal scroll of the current lineup (mini cards) and a stacked preview of the league ranking.

screens.name: League List
screens.purpose: Hub for users to navigate between multiple leagues or create/join new ones.

states.empty: Stylized empty stadium image with primary 'Create League' and 'Join via Code' CTAs.

screens.layout: Stacked list of league cards. Each card displays league name, user's current rank, and total participants. Floating Action Button (FAB) or sticky bottom CTA for Create/Join.

screens.name: League Detail & Leaderboard
screens.purpose: Displays current and overall standings, matchday history, and participants.

states.empty: No matchdays played yet message with an abstract pitch graphic.

screens.layout: Segmented control at the top (Current Matchday vs. Overall). Stacked list leaderboard: each row shows Rank, Avatar/Initials, Username, and Score. Highlight the active user's row with surfaceTertiary. Display a brandSecondary (Amber/Gold) trophy icon on rank 1.

screens.name: Lineup Builder
screens.purpose: The core interactive feature where users drag or tap to select their tactical formation and 11 starters + bench.

states.empty: Empty pitch with '+' slots for players.

screens.layout: Sticky header for module selection (e.g., 4-3-3, 3-5-2). The main area is a graphical football pitch (using dark/glassmorphism) with absolute/flex positioned player slots (P, D, C, A). Tapping a slot opens a bottom sheet to select a player from the filtered roster.

screens.name: Player Roster (Browse)
screens.purpose: Search and filter all available Serie A players by role and team.
screens.layout: Sticky top section with horizontal scrolling chip filters for Roles (P, D, C, A) and Teams. Below is a flat list of player cards showing team logo, name, role, and current matchday points.

screens.name: Admin: Votes Management
screens.purpose: Secure screen for admins to input votes, bonuses, and maluses for a matchday.
screens.layout: List of players with numerical steppers or text inputs for Fantavoto. Sticky 'Save Votes' CTA at the bottom.

screens.name: User Profile
screens.purpose: Personal statistics, badges earned, and account settings.
screens.layout: Top banner using a dark sports texture. Avatar overlapping the banner. Grid of stats (Matchdays won, Highest score) and a stacked list of earned badges.

components.player_card: Horizontal row in lists: Team logo on the left (or kit visual), followed by Player Name (Satoshi, base, 500) and Role badge (P/D/C/A). Trailing element is the current score (Barlow Condensed, xl, brandPrimary).
components.pitch_layout: A container with 'surfaceSecondary' and subtle white/green line markings. Use 'flex' with nested rows for attackers, midfielders, defenders, and goalkeeper to automatically distribute spacing based on the chosen module (e.g. 4-3-3).
components.chip_filters: Horizontal ScrollView of pills. Inactive: surfaceTertiary background, onSurface text. Active: brandPrimary background, onBrandPrimary text. Pill radius.
components.leaderboard_row: Row with md padding. Rank number (Barlow Condensed, large), Avatar (initials if no image), Username. Highlight the winner with a Phosphor Trophy icon filled with brandSecondary (Amber). Active user's row gets a subtle brandTertiary background tint.

empty_state_tactics.alt: Manager planning tactics on a board.

instructions_to_main_agent: Design personality is 7 Dark-First Utility. Emphasize dense, legible statistics combined with premium glassmorphic overlays.
BANNED: Do not use any blue, indigo, or purple hues. Stick strictly to the dark slate base and Pitch Green (brandPrimary) accent.
Use Barlow Condensed for all numerals, scores, and major headers. Use Satoshi for body text and player names.
Implement the sticky primary CTA over scrolling content rule for forms and major actions.

Lineup Builder: The pitch must be visually distinct but not overly bright. Use a dark frosted glass effect or surfaceSecondary with subtle field markings. Players on the pitch should be represented by small tinted icons/kits or circular badges with their role (P/D/C/A).
Leaderboards must display high contrast. Ensure the active user's row is highlighted subtly, and the winner always gets the brandSecondary Trophy icon.
Images MUST use the gradient scrim pattern (transparent to >=70% surfaceInverse) when text is overlaid.
Make sure haptics are integrated for drag-and-drop actions in the lineup builder and when tapping chip filters.
